subject.title: Write tool lacks append mode — isolated cron sessions destroy shared files

question: Should OpenClaw accept `append?: boolean` on the existing `write` tool as the permanent append contract for issue #40001, or require a different append API before closing it?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but the fix is a model-facing tool-contract decision rather than a purely internal repair.

options.title: Accept append flag on write
options.body: Land the open implementation after maintainer review, keeping overwrite as the default and using `append: true` for safe accumulation.

options.title: Choose another append contract
options.body: Ask for a replacement shape such as `mode: "append"` or a dedicated append tool before merging any public API.

options.title: Defer code and document workarounds
options.body: Keep relying on backups or `exec >>` style workarounds, accepting that the ordinary write data-loss risk remains.

recommendation.title: Accept append flag on write
recommendation.body: Land the open implementation after maintainer review, keeping overwrite as the default and using `append: true` for safe accumulation.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice is about the shared model-facing agent tool API, and history points to steipete as the strongest available owner for that boundary.
